'''Corey Boba''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 19th at [[2002 Yavin 4 Regionals]] on 20 April 2002, according to Patrick Hines's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3592">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-21-yavin-iv-regional-directors-reportd3592/ yavin-iv-regional-directors-report], DeckTech (Patrick "ulkafett" Hines, 21 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-21-yavin-iv-regional-directors-reportd3592/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
